Before the meal: a plate of tortellini in tomato sauce, about 200 g on a small paper plate, and an ice cream cone (Dairy-type cone, about 100 g).

Tortellini with sauce runs roughly 150 kcal per 100 g, so 200 g is about 300 kcal. Fresh tortellini with meat filling could be higher, but the portion looks modest, around 25 pieces. At roughly 7 g per piece that is about 175 g of pasta plus sauce, so about 200 g total is a reasonable estimate.

The cone is a Cornetto-style ice cream, about 70 g and roughly 200 kcal for a 120 ml cone.

After the meal: the tortellini are all eaten, with only some sauce left on the plate, so I count about 190 g eaten. The cone wrapper is empty and the ice cream is gone. The water is not food energy.

Totals: pasta about 190 g at 150 kcal per 100 g gives about 285 kcal. The cone adds about 70 g and 200 kcal. That comes to about 485 kcal and 260 g.
